mapper.select: SELECT tt.id AS table_id, tt.user_id AS table_user_id, tt.date, tb.id AS block_id, tb.user_id AS block_user_id, tb.table_id AS block_table_id, tb.title AS block_title, tb.status, tb.width, tb.start_at, tb.color, tbt.id AS task_id, tbt.time_block_id AS task_block_id, tbt.title AS task_title, s.id AS schedule_id, s.user_id AS schedule_user_id, s.kind, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.title AS schedule_title FROM time_tables tt LEFT JOIN time_blocks tb ON tt.id = tb.table_id LEFT JOIN time_block_tasks tbt ON tb.id = tbt.time_block_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON tb.schedule_id = s.id WHERE (tt.user_id = #{userId}) AND (tt.date = #{date})
mapper.update: UPDATE time_tables SET date = #{date} WHERE id = #{id}
